Software companies that move fast win. AWS gives you the broadest set of cloud services, over 100 foundation models through Amazon Bedrock, and hands-on partner support so your team spends more time creating differentiated features and less time on repetitive tasks. How can SaaS cloud providers and SaaS cloud partnerships help me build faster? Specialized cloud expertise is hard to find—but if you don’t have the right support, skills gaps can slow your delivery. Through the AWS Partner Network, you can tap into a global SaaS partner ecosystem of 140,000+ partners worldwide and 30,000+ solutions. You’ll find implementation guidance, best practices, and pre-built integrations that close skills gaps without the cost and lead time of hiring specialist talent. How does AWS help me manage costs as I scale? Unpredictable infrastructure costs slow growth and make it harder to invest with confidence. AWS cloud cost optimization tools and a pay-as-you-go model mean your spend scales with actual usage. As a partner, you can also gain access to co-sell programs that help offset development and go-to-market costs as you grow. How does AWS support global expansion? Entering new markets means navigating unfamiliar regulations, infrastructure requirements, and go-to-market complexity. AWS Global Passport provides operational readiness assessments, technical architecture reviews, and localized growth plans and AWS Marketplace consolidates your revenue operations across 190+ countries so you can engage your buyers in new regions from day one. Why is AWS Marketplace a strategic opportunity for my business? Choosing the right distribution channel can be the difference maker in any SaaS growth strategy. By listing on AWS Marketplace, you can connect directly with millions of active AWS customers through a simplified procurement experience that removes traditional buying friction.
